video-photoshop-tutorial-for-beginners-c.title: Eye Highlights, Tool Groups, and Crop Tricks: Photoshop Tools for Beginners (Lesson 2)
video-photoshop-tutorial-for-beginners-c.summary: This beginner-focused Photoshop lesson teaches practical, repeatable techniques for reinforcing non-destructive editing and core tool navigation. It starts with a quick, hands-on eye-light enhancement using a soft round brush on a new layer and an Overlay blend mode to create bright catch lights. The instructor then dissects the Photoshop toolbar into tool groups, demonstrates non-destructive workflows (new layers, sampling across layers, and tool settings via the Options bar), and walks through patching and removing on separate layers. The session continues with toolbar customization (editing, hiding, and saving presets such as Pix Minimal), followed by foundational cropping basics, including delete-cropped-pixels caution, fixed vs freehand ratios, and the straightening workflow with a reference point that can be moved with Alt/Option. The video also covers Generative Expand (AI-assisted content-aware expansion), model prompts, and option handling, plus Move tool behavior, alignment options (align to selection vs align to canvas), and a hybrid approach for temporarily enabling Auto Select with a Ctrl/Cmd modifier. Throughout, the educator emphasizes practical shortcuts, workflow hygiene, and practicing on a separate layer to stay non-destructive, ending with encouragement to follow along and apply these tools to own projects.

video-photoshop-tutorial-for-beginners-c.title: Photoshop Beginner Lesson 1: Workspace, Panels, and Basic File Management (PiXimperfect)
video-photoshop-tutorial-for-beginners-c.summary: PiXimperfect’s Photoshop for Complete Beginners: Start Here (Lesson 1) guides new users through core concepts and setup for Photoshop. It starts with what Photoshop does and explains pixels and megapixels, then covers installing or updating via Creative Cloud, and distinguishes the Home screen from the work space. The video demonstrates how to switch and customize workspaces, save a personal setup, and organize panels, followed by a practical hands-on project that introduces brushes, text, and layers. It then walks through saving practices (Save, Save As, PSD), exporting for web (JPEG/PNG), and essential navigation shortcuts, including transform controls, zoom/pan techniques, and the contextual taskbar that adapts to the active tool. The session culminates with quick tips on undo/redo, layout fundamentals (canvas/tools/panels), and a reminder of how to access any missing panels via the Window menu.

video-photoshop-tutorial-for-beginners-c.title: Master Creative Tools - Photoshop for Beginners | Lesson 3
video-photoshop-tutorial-for-beginners-c.summary: This PiXimperfect lesson introduces core Photoshop creative tools for beginners through hands‑on brushing, coloring, and non‑destructive editing techniques. The video demonstrates painting with the brush on different blend modes (notably Difference) to reveal interaction with underlying colors, switching between foreground and background colors, and using new layers to keep edits non‑destructive. It covers essential brush fundamentals (tip shapes, opacity vs flow, and smoothing), practical shortcuts ( Bracket keys for size; tilde for erasing while painting; keyboard shortcuts for tools), and the Rotate View/Sticky Shortcuts workflow that accelerates tool switching. The session also dives into removal and healing workflows (Remove Tool, Patch Tool, Content‑Aware Fill) with both manual and AI‑assisted options, and culminates with advanced selection techniques (Lasso, Select Subject, Object Selection with cloud vs device processing) and quick background removal via masks and adjustment layers. The overall message encourages experimentation and non‑destructive practice using practice files or personal images.
